title: Playwright and agent-browser CLI in sandbox
hook: How can agents now verify UI changes and reproduce browser-based bugs?

back.lead: Playwright and the agent-browser CLI are now available in the agent's sandbox, letting it open apps in a real browser, click through flows, reproduce browser-based bugs, and verify UI changes.
back.hookline: Agents can now test what they build in a real browser before you look.

kv.v: Open apps, click flows, reproduce bugs, verify UI
